notes.title: Update 1.1 - Checkpoint Update
notes.content:
Checkpoint Gamemode
When beginning a new game you may now choose between playing with or without Checkpoints!
Checkpoints have been scattered throughout Inferno to help reduce some of the suffering that comes from larger falls. If you would like a less stressful experience of hell, this game mode is for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/d330cb37aaf7af6d4149f5c9468e9456459ec51c.png

Just keep an eye out for one these gravestones and you will be able to respawn here after a large fall!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/1a651cf426866cdde7bcbc820f3f9b8ccbf6185e.png

Wrath Update
Wrath has recieved a small bit of love, with a new sliding effect for the shutes at the top of the level. To successfully beat this section will require fast reflexes and careful coordination as you juggle Vincent over the large gaps of the shute.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/c7fcfbc5801f9bc86a38a4d30f84bab548ac7412.png

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with the training grounds that caused the game to crash when opening the menu.
Fixed an issue with the Wrath training grounds that caused some platforms to have no hitboxes (the level should be completable now)
Fixed an issue with the Heresy training grounds causing it to be unbeatable.
Fixed an issue with the tutorial training grounds causing it to reward you with a rating of D instead of B+
Cleaned Up some collisions in Treachery, Fraud, Wrath & Greed
Added some train SFX in Heresy
Cleaned up some Menu UI!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/fb860e5f2608dd9ec162e1451a7eb5d8ee9a6fd4.png

Get a copy of the Ascending Inferno OST
Our OST composed by Dan Poole and featuring Amelia Jones is now available to be purchased!

This album features the main theme, and the tracks for each level throughout the game (including the tutorial).
All Proceeds go directly to Dan Pool, our talented composer!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50903/Ascending_Inferno__Original_Soundtrack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312870/Ascending_Inferno_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This update unlocks the training ground game mode! available from the Main Menu!
It also addresses several bugs that have been pointed out since launch!

Training Ground Game Mode
Once you have successfully beaten a level in the game mode, you will unlock it in the training grounds!
The training grounds provide a way for you to practice any of the levels you have beaten once before, so that you can find shortcuts, limit test, and beat your times!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/5077a7aaf87e111cbdbfc9921baa8354caf804e8.png
Your best time for each training ground is automatically saved, and after each run you are granted a score from D to S+ (earning an S or higher will grant you an achievement for the level!) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/cb315b8617a34a2595051770e837c22455c4ac4d.png
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the customisation menu not allowing you to select a customisation for Vincent.
 Fixed an issue with the customisation menu with Vincent's wings & hat not appearing.
 Fixed an issue with the customisation menu with being able to hit the left and right button infinitely.
 Fixed some collision issues, including being able to stand on the lust door frame.
 Fixed an issue with the falling achievement, it now tracks your total meters fallen during gameplay.
 Fixed an issue with Vincent being off-screen with the height tracker, in the bottom of limbo.
 Fixed an issue with AO rendering through transparency
 Fixed the hard lock in the Wrath Secret Room, where Vincent could get stuck on the roof.
 Fixed an issue with the Wrath music being cut off halfway through.
 Fixed some collision issues in Violence, allowing Vincent to get stuck in small Gaps.
 Fixed an Audio Overlapping issue

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/6e1f14678ba20e890622a6ef6ff43f61223026c1.png
Quality of Life Changes

 Lust is now slightly easier! (The dancers in the rave room in particular are less punishing)
 Added dead zone to the controller joystick.
 Added the ability to customise the Jump on the D-pad for controller

notes.title: Alpha Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Summary:
·         New music!
·         Dialogue system and narrative secret rooms!
·         Ball cam!
·         Tons of optimisation and performance improvement!
·         Tutorial visual revamp!
·         Training grounds are now unlocked!
·         And so much more 👀👀👀👀
 
Details: 
New Music Tracks in Limbo and Lust. 
These tracks aren’t finished but should convey the vibe we’re going for. 
 
New Dialogue System.
New system in place for our main narrative beats. For players who want to dive deeper into the narrative and the character dynamics between Dani and Vincent, we have hidden the narrative behind secret rooms and areas. Be on the lookout for these secret rooms. 
 
Ball Cam.
You now get front row seats to your mistakes! Now, whenever Vincent is off screen, a camera will appear in the top right to show where he is.
 
NOTE: This is a high performance cost feature, as it’s essentially rendering the game twice to function. Ball Cam is currently switched off by default, but you can enable it in the settings if you would like to try/ you have a powerful PC.
 
Tutorial Visual Revamp.
Our tutorial section has been somewhat of the unloved child of the game. It’s now had a visual revamp that brings it in line with our other levels and as a result is much prettier! (We love it now we swear!!)
 
Tons of Optimization
There are way too many to count! Across the board you should see higher performance and FPS. As well as our graphics settings have had an overhaul with a lot more love given to lower end systems whilst still passing the Oppolyon vibe check. (Even on low settings the game looks real nice)
 
 The Training Grounds
The training grounds are a way of practising levels that you have already completed in the main game, access them from the main menu and good luck trying to beat your PBs!

notes.content:
New Character animations:
- Run
- Jump
- Idle

New Dialogue System!
- Idle

- Bouncing head
- Kicking far

New Particle Effects!

- Small Kick
- Headbutt

Screen Shake! 

New SFX!
Vincent and Dani have voices!

Performance Improvements!
Lust and Tutorial should be much more performant
game as a whole should run better now

Limbo & Lust have received visual updates!
- New 2D Sprites throughout the levels!
- improved texturing in limbo
- Hellish portal & general hell themes have been introduced into limbo
- Lust Dancers (animated too!)
- New post processing effects!

Rebalanced the difficulty of the tutorial & early limbo.

Full Controller support & remapping is now supported
New UI to support this update is coming soon!

Bug Fixes:
- Can now run and kick without nullifying the kick power!
- Can now jump with the ball and not accidentally bonk the ball on your head!
- Fixed duplicate UI on the main menu sometimes appearing!
- Vincent trail doesn't do squiggles at low fps

notes.title: Alpha 0.2
notes.content:
We got a new update!! 🥳 🥳 

PATCH 13/08/2023

General
Tutorial has been reworked and is now much less punishing!
New Tutorial GIFS explain game mechanics! (May need to turn off and on again in settings)
Big Optimisation Changes (We are very interested in the kind of FPS you get now!)
Limbo dungeon is now easier too!
New speed running stats displayed for each level!
Progress Bar shows you how close you are to completing the Demo.
New Ball Trail 😍

Bug Fixes
Music and SFX shouldn't turn on randomly if its been turned off.
Fixed Getting stuck behind a box in the Tutorial!
Ball Physics may or may not be the same. (It's been a while so we can't remember :( )
Tutorial tells you the correct keybindings for game-pad now!
And various minor things 🙂

Thanks so much for the feedback we've received so far! Hopefully these changes make life in hell a little easier 🙂 
We've got plenty more to come that still needs time in the oven, so keep an eye on this page 👀
